description.value: Dutch Lake Resort & RV Park sits on the shore of Dutch Lake in Clearwater, BC, at the gateway to Wells Gray Provincial Park — one of BC's largest and most spectacular wilderness parks featuring 41 named waterfalls. The resort's on-site restaurant, The Painted Turtle, operates seasonally and offers breakfast, lunch, and dinner to guests and visitors. It sits along the travel corridor between Jasper, Sun Peaks, and Vancouver, making it a potential stop for touring cyclists traversing central BC.
